description.value: While raging, shoving a creature into a wall, obstacle, or another creature causes it to suffer kinetic damage equal to your rage damage. Additionally, the first time each turn that you connect with a melee attack using your Strength, you can try to carry the blow into a second target: pick another creature within 5 feet of the one you hit and within your reach, and if your attack roll would also have hit it, it takes damage equal to your Strength modifier, of the same type your original attack dealt.
